paper_metadata.title: Effect of Alloying Elements on the High-Temperature Yielding Behavior of Multicomponent γ′-L12 Alloys

evidence.quote: The multicomponent γ′ (L12-ordered) single phase was designed by utilizing the Thermo-Calc© TCNI8 database [30], aiming to obtain L12-ordered single phase within the temperature range between 800 ◦C and 950 ◦C. We developed three systems, as follows: • NiCoCrAl, • NiCoCrAlTi, • NiCoCrAlNb.
